CUL — Cultural Tour

Stone Town walking tour

2–4 hours · Stone Town

From $13–$80 per person
Book via WhatsApp

Overview

Walk through the heart of Zanzibar's UNESCO World Heritage site with a licensed local guide. Discover 200 years of history — from the Sultan's palace to the bustling-forbidden market scene, the House of Wonders, and the Old Fort.

What to Expect

  • 2–4 hour guided walk led by a Zanzibar-licensed guide
  • Visit Forodhani Gardens night market (if evening)
  • Explore the Old Fort, House of Wonders, and Sultan's Palace Museum
  • Browse the Darajani and Forodhani markets
  • Stroll the seafront promenade and the Old City gates

Duration & Meeting Point

Duration: 2–4 hours (customizable: morning or late afternoon)

Meeting point: Forodhani Gardens, Stone Town waterfront

Important Notes

  • Entry fees to museums are not included — budget $5–10 extra
  • Wear comfortable walking shoes; Stone Town has uneven surfaces
  • Bring a hat and water; midday sun is intense
  • Licensed guides charge per group, not per person — perfect for families

Inclusions

  • Licensed guide
  • entry fees vary
